text: Levamisole kills lung worms and intestinal worms, but many farmers have shifted to Ivermectin because it also covers external parasites; historically Levamisole was preferred when Ivermectin was expensive, but cheap (and not always reliable-quality) Ivermectin is now widely available. 'Super' Ivermectin products combine Ivermectin with Clorsulon, which is active against adult Fasciola (liver fluke) but not its eggs, so regular use is needed for real control of liver fluke.
caveat: Product names and formulations reflect the source manual (circa 2013) and may have changed; always follow current label instructions and local veterinary guidance.
